mission.title: THE LAST SHIPMENT
mission.intro: You've successfully collected all four encrypted clues. Now it's time to decrypt them, uncover the hidden evidence, and discover who kidnapped Noor.
mission.phase1: Decrypt all four evidence files (15 minutes)
mission.phase2: Analyze the evidence and identify the kidnapper (25 minutes)

Staff Activity Audit
CLASSIFICATION: CONFIDENTIAL — INVESTIGATION USE ONLY

FILE 04 · STAFF_ACTIVITY_AUDIT

============================================================
Security System Information
============================================================
Temporary Shipping Access Cards require approval from an authorized Security Officer.
The Security Account displayed in an access log identifies the officer who approved the temporary access.

It does not necessarily identify the employee physically carrying the card.

Personal authentication: the Secure Procurement Room, the Secure Procurement Workstation and the Gate B Employee Exit Turnstile each require a personal smart badge plus fingerprint verification. A badge alone is not accepted.

recovery.question: TEST QUESTION (replace before the event). Rami hid one word in his last note with a Caesar cipher: every letter was moved 3 places forward in the alphabet (A became D, B became E). The note says ZDUHKRXVH. Decrypt it and enter the word.
